evals.name: remove-panic-path
evals.prompt: Audit a function with unchecked interface type assertion 'val := obj.(string)' and raw pointer dereferences.
evals.expected_output: Replacing panicking code with comma-ok type assertions and explicit nil checks.
assertions: Uses comma-ok type assertion 'val, ok := obj.(string)' and handles !ok.
Checks pointers for nil before dereferencing.
Returns clean errors instead of triggering runtime panics.

evals.name: defensive-slice-copy
evals.prompt: An internal domain struct contains a slice of roles. Ensure external callers cannot mutate internal state.
evals.expected_output: Getter returning a defensive copy of the slice rather than internal reference.
assertions: Allocates a new slice and copies elements with copy().
Returns the copy to prevent external mutation of internal slice buffer.
Accepts defensive copy in constructor/setter as well.

evals.name: resource-cleanup-defer
evals.prompt: Read an HTTP response body and ensure connection and resources are safely closed under all error conditions.
evals.expected_output: Correct placement of defer resp.Body.Close() after checking resp != nil and err == nil.
assertions: Checks err == nil before accessing resp.Body.
Defers resp.Body.Close() immediately after error check.
Drains body with io.Copy(io.Discard, resp.Body) if connection reuse is required.
